full.checkpointSelection: minimum development mean cross-entropy; earliest epoch wins ties

testPolicy: No held-out or corpus-v1 inference until both full-seed candidates and selection rule are frozen. No post-test tuning or training extensions.

promotion.exactBoardNumerator: reliable exact boards (all 64 squares at confidence >= 0.7)
promotion.corpusV1Regression: No loss of reliable exact boards or correct squares and no increase in reliable wrong compared with shipped weights on identical frozen vectors.

dataQuality.renderer: pinned Chromium SVG to RGBA/PNG; native PNG compositing only
dataQuality.requiredBeforeTraining: Canonical data-quality.json with automated correctness checks and lead visual review bound to dataset hash
dataQuality.priorExposure: New boards and vectors from the same source families. RhosGFX source family and v1 test outcomes were previously exposed; this is corrected-renderer replication, not blind independent source-family validation.

preservation.policy: Original protocol, generator, sources, manifests, reports, vectors and candidates remain byte-identical.
